notes: Constructed inputs run against checks with the expected outcome sealed in the case definition. Week 1 deliverable 2. Development material: every case was written with the ledger in view.
name: blinded_guard_challenge
why_not: every case has saw_ledger=true, so the set measures whether the harness discriminates, not whether a blinded search finds anything
what_this_licenses: the claim that the harness separates a missed scientific failure from an algebraic identity and from ordinary input validation
what_this_does_not_license: a failure rate, a field-wide prevalence, or the week-1 stop-rule decision
